name: I would rather keep this informal for now. I run a landscaping company with two crews on the South Shore
needs: I miss a lot of calls because everyone is out on job sites. Nobody is in the office, and you cannot answer a phone on a mower.
People leave a voicemail, and by the time we call back at night, they have hired someone else. I would say we lose ten jobs a month that way in the summer.
I write them on paper in the truck. Sometimes they get lost before they get to the client, or my wife cannot read my handwriting. It is a bit of a mess.
I would like to stop writing quotes on paper by next spring. I do not know what that looks like yet, maybe something on the phone.
goals: Just not losing those jobs. If every caller heard back within an hour, I think most of them would book with us.
Stop writing quotes on paper by next spring.
